ACT XIX OF 2020
EDUCATION CITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Education City Act, 2013
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-14/2020,
dated 12.8.2020.---The Education
City (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Sindh on 23rd July, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 05th
August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Education
City Act, 2013, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Education City (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
